items.title: World Bank approves $300 million to improve Bangladesh’s primary education
items.description: The World Bank today approved $300 million (Tk 3,736 crore) to strengthen pre-primary and primary education in Bangladesh, benefiting 2.6 crore children through improved classrooms, learning materials and school uniforms.
